objects: tables:all LLD-05 tables declared by the seven schema_sources
indexes:all required_indexes and uniqueness/partial-index guards declared by those schema_sources
triggers:all append-only/history/current-projection/nonempty/nonoverlap/identity protection guards declared by those schema_sources
cross_packet_reference_policy: LLD-05 may physically reference already-migrated LLD-01 command receipts/replay-result Foundation authority, LLD-03 Service Request/RFC/Device Reference identities and LLD-02 canonical IDs where the schema declares a physical FK.

LLD-04 immutable source evidence identities are source-owner references validated through the accepted LLD-04 handoff/provider contract; their presence never authorizes local execution/outcome and no source status is rewritten by LLD-05.

LLD-07 Inventory dependencies are runtime participant/provider relationships; sequence 6 creates no FK into future sequence-8 Inventory tables, preventing a migration-order cycle and preventing Inventory from owning Task lifecycle.
verification: all LLD-05 owned tables are SQLite STRICT where declared
foreign_key_check succeeds immediately after sequence 6 without future migrations
all physical FK child paths have accepted leading-prefix indexes
Task No and MW tracking identifiers preserve exact format/uniqueness/nonreuse rules

wfm_task_no_retirements is append-only immutable nonreuse authority; retired_task_id intentionally has no tasks FK because the Task is physically removed in the same eligible HardDeleteTask UnitOfWork

retirement insert is accepted only when hard_delete_command_id is the exact current HardDeleteTask receipt targeting retired_task_id and the current wfm_task_identities row binds the same task_no/task_id; wfm_task_identities insert rejects any task_no present in retirement authority

wfm_rfc_assignment_events reject UPDATE and ordinary DELETE; DELETE is permitted only for the sole registration-baseline event of an exact HardDeleteTask-targeted source-free wfm_manual Task, with prior_rfc_id null, new_rfc_id equal to current_rfc_id and event.command_id equal to wfm_task_identities.created_command_id; any second assignment event blocks the exception

objective_membership_events reject UPDATE and ordinary DELETE; DELETE is permitted only for creation-baseline add events of an exact HardDeleteObjective-targeted untouched manual Objective, with from_objective_id null, to_objective_id equal to the target, grouping_proposal_id null and event.command_id equal to objectives.created_command_id; any later/nonbaseline membership event blocks the exception
current Task plan may differ from membership-pinned plan without silent Objective envelope rewrite
current nonsuperseded Objective nonempty and global strict-overlap guards are installed and verified
no trigger derives actual execution/outcome from source plan, current plan, Objective envelope or provider Complete
rollback: No runtime down migration in Beta 1.0. LLD-01 applies and verifies sequence 6 atomically; failure never exposes a partially migrated Objectives/Tasks schema.
